resources.string: View saved computer keys and revoke debugging access for individual computers.

Manage the system’s “Always allow” ADB debugging keys without an additional root grant. Temporary grants and system keys are excluded. USB and wireless debugging may share keys; keys alone cannot identify the connection type. Revoking a key affects debugging connections that use it. Computer names come from the keys; check the fingerprint too.
No saved debugging authorizations. Connect a computer and select “Always allow” in the system authorization dialog to manage it here.

Revoke debugging access for “%1$s”?

Key fingerprint:
%2$s

This may disconnect this computer’s current USB or wireless debugging session. Debugging again requires authorization. Other keys are unaffected.
Verified: debugging authorization for this key was revoked.
This system does not expose a compatible API for individual authorizations. Android 11 or later with a compatible ROM is required. Enable the module and restart the device.
Could not read debugging authorizations. Make sure the module is enabled and the device has been restarted, then refresh.
Could not confirm revocation. Disconnect debugging sessions for this computer, enable USB debugging once if needed, then refresh and retry.
Too many saved keys to safely retrieve a complete list. Revocation is unavailable.
This computer still has an active debugging connection. Disconnect its USB and wireless debugging sessions, then refresh and revoke authorization.
